Congress Questions Minister Puri Over Purported Epstein Photos

Congress leaders have targeted the government over purported viral images of Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri with Jeffrey Epstein. Rahul Gandhi questioned which "anti-national traitor" the US was blackmailing, while the Congress party stated that the Modi-Shah "silence points to criminal indifference." Other opposition leaders also questioned the alleged meeting, with one stating "This is the beginning." The controversy emerged amid a US Department of Justice release.
